Text.Language: I open my mouth with praise / And sing with holy hymns / For the beloved of Christ / Peniot Abba Ywmac
At the mountain near Akhmeem / There was the holy saint / From the (lobas askim) / Peniot Abba Ywmac
From two holy parents / Two respected saints / He lived between two mountains / Peniot Abba Ywmac
Continuous in prayers / And the love of our God / The angel of the Lord came to him / Peniot Abba Ywmac
He had a beautiful voice / And did not cease to learn / The hymns and spiritual songs / Peniot Abba Ywmac
Once he was praying the psalms / A great scene appeared to him / Three in lighting clothing / Peniot Abba Ywmac
They were praying diligently / With praises and hymns / Holy monks of God / Peniot Abba Ywmac
He was visited by the pride of the saints / The faithful St. Shenouda / The holy archimandrite / Peniot Abba Ywmac
St. Thomas gave him / A sign from heaven / About the day of departure / Peniot Abba Ywmac
A solid hard rock / For the archimandrite / Will be split in half / Peniot Abba Ywmac
The Lord appeared to him / Strengthened and comforted him / Promised him the crown of life Peniot Abba Ywmac
The promise was fulfilled / From the Holy and Mighty one / The saint departed to heaven / Peniot Abba Ywmac
There were storms and thunders / The strong stone was broken / Split in two halves / Peniot Abba Ywmac
St. Shenouda with great grief / Remembered the promised scene / The departure of the Star of Shensheef / Peniot Abba Ywmac
They buried the great saint / With his holy brothers / Three holy saints / Peniot Abba Ywmac
Beloved Saints / Servants of the Lord of Lords / Of which was Akhnokh and Yousab / Peniot Abba Ywmac
On the 27th of Bashans / Four hundred and fifty three / He joined the heavenly hosts / Peniot Abba Ywmac
He ended his life with success / Righteousness and holiness / He became one of the hermits / Peniot Abba Ywmac
Peace to you O great one / Who wears the Eskeem / The Light of Shensheef / Peniot Abba Ywmac
We loved your life / The holiness of your asceticism / Remember us in your prayers / Peniot Abba Ywmac
Remember O Lord our Pope / Our bishops and our priests / Through the prayers of our saint / Peniot Abba Ywmac
The meaning of your name / On the tongues of the faithful / All pray to the Lord / For St. Thomas to help us
